newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia foreign minister to visit Britain.
newsitem.headline: Colombia foreign minister to visit Britain.

text.p: Colombian Foreign Relations Minister Maria Emma Mejia will travel to London for a three-day official visit starting February 10, ministry officials said Thursday.
Mejia will hold talks with her opposite number Malcolm Rifkind on bilateral issues inlcuding trade, investment, scientific and technical cooperation, the environment and human rights.

"Judicial cooperation will also be a central theme of the meetings because Great Britain has shown interest in the development of legislation regarding asset forfeiture," a ministry press release said.
Mejia is also scheduled to meet representatives of London- based human rights organization Amnesty International. The group has been highly critical of Colombia's human rights record.
